visual_story_test.input: Three silent excerpts from the same Cinestudy festival B-roll recording: 0-8s, 68-80s, 98-110s. This is not an independent multicamera dataset.

runs.request: Make a 15-second visual story about the festival as a shared gathering, from the audience and stage to people spending time together. Use only visible evidence, not invented speech, emotions or chronology.
runs.title: A Festival Shared Together

story.premise: People gather outdoors to watch together: seated before a stage, lining a shaded path as a costumed procession passes, and sharing space around a fairground umbrella.

beats.purpose: Establish the shared gathering with audience seated before the outdoor stage
Show spectators and costumed walkers sharing the tree-lined path during the procession
Show people spending time together around the fairground umbrella

missingEvidence: Performer in red on stage is distant and uncertain and not used to identify performance content
No timed speech is available, so story is visual only with no spoken turns

shots.reason: Wide view of seated audience facing stage establishes shared gathering
Spectators standing along shaded path watching approaching procession
Costumed pair in green gown and feathered hat walks past onlookers
Line of uniformed attendants with staffs and drums marches past spectators
Costumed performer and seated visitor share space under fairground umbrella

runs.request: Change the perspective to how the costumed participants prepared for the festival and then interacted. If preparation is not actually shown, explicitly record that missing evidence and make a bounded 15-second story about their visible interactions instead. Reduce stage/audience coverage. Do not infer emotions, motives or relationships.
runs.title: Costumed Participants Interacting

story.premise: No preparation is shown. Costumed participants are visible walking forward along a path, marching past onlookers with staffs and drums, and standing holding an item near others at a fairground.

beats.purpose: Show costumed pair walking forward along the path
Show uniformed attendants marching past along the same path
Show costumed performer standing holding an item near seated visitor and passersby

missingEvidence: No scenes show costumed participants preparing, dressing, rehearsing, or waiting before the festival
Stage and audience coverage reduced per request; stage performance moment not used
No timed speech is available, so story is visual only
